<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_MarketingCampaign" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/marketing-campaign">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MarketingCampaign" name="Marketing Campaign" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Campaign" name="Campaign process started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DefineObjectives" name="Define campaign objectives and target audience">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateContent" name="Create content and design visuals">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectChannels" name="Select promotion channels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LaunchCampaign" name="Launch campaign">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrackPerformance" name="Track campaign performance in real time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectLeads" name="Collect leads in CRM system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" name="Campaign period ends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzePerformance" name="Analyze campaign performance for future optimization">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Campaign" name="Campaign process concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Campaign" targetRef="Task_DefineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_DefineObjectives" targetRef="Task_CreateContent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CreateContent" targetRef="Task_SelectChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_SelectChannels" targetRef="Task_LaunchCampaign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_LaunchCampaign" targetRef="Task_TrackPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_TrackPerformance" targetRef="Task_CollectLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_CollectLeads" targetRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" targetRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance" targetRef="EndEvent_Campaign"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
